scope: anima root filesystem and mounted /data, /data2, /data3 volumes
statement: The encrypted copies named by the 2026-08-31 recovery record were not found during a read-only live audit. Replacement ciphertext was created from the matching private key using the Keychain-held recovery secret, copied to local restricted storage and anima, checksum-verified at both locations, recovered without writing plaintext to disk, and used for a disposable sign/verify drill. These online copies restore recoverability but do not satisfy the separate removable/offline-media requirement.
